bugReport.consentIntro: The report goes to this server's bug report admins, in a room that is not end-to-end encrypted: they and the server can read it. It holds:
bugReport.contentsMessages: This message and up to 50 messages before it (in a thread: its first message and up to 200 replies), with their reactions and latest edits
bugReport.contentsAccount: The room's name and ID, and your user ID, device ID and homeserver
bugReport.contentsDevice: The app version, platform, browser, language, time zone, window size and page address
bugReport.contentsDiagnostics: Diagnostic records of the app's recent activity: timings and error types, no message text
bugReport.encryptedTextLeftOut: Message text from this encrypted room is left out: the report keeps each message's sender, time and type.
bugReport.includeTextWarning: The text of these messages will be stored unencrypted in the report room, readable by its admins and the server.
